name: plugin-manager
description: List, validate, and test naitv-mcp plugin manifests under a filesystem root (developer tooling).
author: madicen

entries.name: list_plugins
entries.body: List plugin manifests under root_path (plugins/*/plugin.json or */plugin.json). Filesystem discovery only — not the installed-store list from naitv-mcp core.

fields.params: [{"name":"root_path","description":"Absolute path to a plugins repo or plugins directory","required":true}]

entries.name: validate_plugin
entries.body: Validate one plugin manifest under root_path (entry kinds, delivery, tool fields, bodies).

fields.params: [{"name":"root_path","description":"Absolute path to a plugins repo or plugins directory","required":true},{"name":"plugin","description":"Plugin directory name","required":true}]

entries.name: test_plugin
entries.body: Test a plugin: layers=lint (default, in-process) or layers=l2 (contract runner when root_path is this repo).

fields.params: [{"name":"root_path","description":"Absolute path to a plugins repo or plugins directory","required":true},{"name":"plugin","description":"Plugin directory name","required":true},{"name":"layers","description":"lint (default) or l2","required":false}]
